spans.s: केरक केरक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

केरल केरल, आस्, m. pl., N. of the inha-
bitants of Malabar; (अस्), m. sing. a king of the
Keralas; N. of a son of Ākrīḍa, from whom the
people of Kerala are derived; (ई), f. a kind of
science; astronomical science; an astronomical Śāstra
or treatise; a Hora or period of time equal to about
one hour; (अम्), n., N. of the country inhabited by
the Keralas.
—केरलोत्पत्ति (˚ल-उत्˚), इस्, f., N. of
a work.

केरलक, आस्, m. pl., N. of the inhabitants of
Malabar.
